title: Bopdev Ghat closure reported till 14 January
detail: A closure until 14 January for road work was reported. The year of the notice wasn't confirmed, so check before using this route.

title: Dive Ghat short closures for widening
detail: Two-hour closures have been announced for road widening. Check the day's traffic notice.

title: Malshej Ghat shut after road collapse in heavy rain
detail: A road collapse shut traffic during heavy rain. Treat Malshej as a monsoon-risk road and check news before going.

title: Expressway missing link is open
detail: The 13.3 km missing link opened on 1 May 2026 and bypasses the old ghat section, saving about 30 minutes.

title: Pune–Satara–Kolhapur works and holiday jams
detail: Flyover and upgrade works continue, Khambatki tunnel is in its final stage, and long jams were reported over Diwali. Leave by 6 AM on holiday weekends.

title: Mumbai–Goa highway still not fully four-laned
detail: Ministers target completion by the end of 2026, but stretches remain under work with diversions. Prefer daylight driving and allow extra time.

title: Varandha Ghat closes every monsoon
detail: Closed until 31 August in the monsoon for landslide risk. Fine in winter.
